access_key_id.description: Access Key ID for access key authentication.

access_key_secret.description: Access Key Secret for access key authentication.

auth_type.description: Access approach. Supported values: IAM_ROLE, ACCESS_KEY, PUBLIC_BUCKET.

bucket.description: The S3 bucket name containing the Guidewire CDA export. Required for connector creation.

is_private_link_required.description: Set to `true` if you want to connect to S3 bucket over PrivateLink. Default value: `false`.

manifest_path.description: The path to the Guidewire CDA manifest.json file in the S3 bucket.

role_arn.description: The Role ARN required for IAM role authentication.

access_key_id.description: ESM key for access Key ID for access key authentication.
